ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based sandbox for practicing company-style Online Assessments, featuring real-time evaluation of DSA problems like Longest Subarray With Equal 0s and 1s alongside automated DBMS and Computer Networks MCQs.
ideas.title: JavaOA-Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core focus of the assessment format by providing a rigorous platform for practicing the exact types of DSA coding questions and technical MCQs evaluated in the exam.

ideas.pitch: A Java-backed visualization tool specifically designed to step through array and sliding window algorithms, such as finding minimum platforms and equal 0/1 subarrays, to aid conceptual mastery.
ideas.title: DSA-Pattern-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a core technical fundamental measured in the assessment by offering deep visualization into complex algorithmic state changes.

ideas.pitch: A robust command-line and web quiz engine targeting core Java concepts, multithreading, and memory management with instant performance analytics and conceptual breakdowns.
ideas.title: CoreJava-QuizEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the high weightage of Java Programming MCQs in the assessment syllabus by reinforcing tricky core language concepts.

ideas.pitch: A spaced-repetition and dynamic testing platform focusing strictly on DBMS fundamentals and Computer Networks protocols to help students clear technical screening rounds.
ideas.title: Network-DB-Flashcards
ideas.why_it_could_win: Covers the technical MCQ domain requirements of the online assessment with targeted question banks and immediate feedback loops.

ideas.pitch: An individual performance analytics tracker that simulates online assessment constraints, timing, and negative marking patterns for Java developers preparing for technical evaluations.
ideas.title: OA-Performance-Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the rigorous time management constraints and individual competition format required by company-style online assessments.
